# IP-NNN — Descriptive Outcome

Template only. Replace placeholders and trim unnecessary sections when generating a plan. See [Plan Generation Instructions](../plan-generation-instructions.md).

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Roadmap milestone | RNN |
| Status | Pending |
| Implementation owner | User by default; agent implementation on request |
| Depends on | Existing plans/artifacts, or none |
| Resume at | First concrete action |

## Outcome

Describe the useful artifact or behavior the implementer will produce.

## Scope

State the bounded work and important exclusions. Link relevant decisions and prerequisites.

## Completion criteria

- Observable behavior or artifact.
- Relevant correctness/compatibility evidence.
- Known limitations and manual evidence gaps recorded honestly.

## Implementation steps

### 1. First useful increment

**Build:** What to implement and where, once the repository structure is known.

**Context:** Explain the unfamiliar concept needed for this step, briefly.

**Check:** Expected behavior and the smallest useful verification. Include commands when known.

**Checkpoint:** What constitutes a safe pause and what the next step depends on.

Repeat for the bounded set of steps needed for this outcome.

## State and verification

| Step | Implementation status | Agent/automated evidence | Manual reporting state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Pending | Not run | Unreported |

Record evidence details in the Progress Log and link them from the generated plan. For checks that do not involve a manual observation, use `Not applicable` rather than inventing a manual requirement.

## Resume and follow-up

Record the precise next action, blockers if any, and likely follow-up outcome. Future plans remain ungenerated until needed.
